text_block_list.text:
Heading up to the rooftop for a change of 
pace—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A happy ending!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! And they lived happily ever 
after. A happy ending... right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Rice was just reading a 
picture book to me! Rice is super good at 
reading them!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-That's not... Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Picture books end so fast that you can 
read a whole bunch of 'em! Wanna have me 
read one to you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo loves stories where hard workers 
find happiness. So today's story is one of 
those...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer?! What kind of 
stories do you like?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo likes happy endings! Sad ones make 
Turbo sad, so I hate 'em!
choice_data_list:
I want a story with a protagonist like 
Twin Turbo

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Like Turbo? Super fast!? Rice, is there 
one!? A story where Turbo is the main 
character!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Nothing comes to mind right away, 
but maybe Rob Roy-san would know...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Then let's go ask!! Hurry, 
hurry~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roooy!! Tell me about a picture book 
where Turbo's the hero!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Huh? A story where Turbo-san is the 
main character...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. When was it published? I'm so 
sorry, I...

I briefly explain what was discussed on 
the rooftop. Zenno Rob Roy murmured, "I 
see," pondering for a moment—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, there are stories, but most of 
them are novels... Of course, I recommend 
all of them, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Where are the picture books!? Aren't 
there any picture books!? Novels are too 
long, so I can't read them at *ZOOM* 
speed!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But... Turbo wants to read a picture 
book where Turbo is the main character...

Seeing her dejected face, I just can't 
bring myself to tell her to give up. In 
that case, we might as well—
choice_data_list:
Why not try thinking about it and making 
it yourself?

Why not try steadily working your way 
through a novel?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: By myself...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds wonderful...!! A picture book 
with Turbo-san as the protagonist... I 
think that's lovely!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I-I want to see it too... Because I know 
it's going to be a fun... and happy 
story...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...! Then I'll make it!! Rice, Rob Roy, 
help me out!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course. If there's anything I can do 
to help...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. Rice will do her best too...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Once it's done, I'll show you too, 
Trainer! I wonder what role I should give 
you!! Allriiight! Let's do thiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hehehe.

The three of them giggled in hushed tones 
in the library. The picture book is sure 
to be a cheerful, bright... happy-ending 
story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's true... It might be long, 
but that just means you can get completely 
immersed in the story...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if it's a novel you're looking 
for, I know of a protagonist who's quite 
like Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Always energetic, cheerful, smiling... 
just completely positive. It's such a fun 
protagonist and story.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So cheerful and fun...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You and Rice think so too, Trainer?! Does 
that mean I'm like Turbo?! Hey, hey, like 
Turbo?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. Sounds like Turbo-san. I kind of 
want to read it too...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...! Then, I'll read it!! Let's all read 
it together!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If we're together, it doesn't matter how 
long it is! Rice, Rob Roy, Trainer, and 
Turbo!! We'll take turns reading it all 
together!!

Borrowing the novel from the library, we 
headed back to the rooftop. Taking turns 
reading aloud. It was time-consuming and 
challenging, but—

Looking into Twin Turbo's excited eyes, I 
didn't feel any hardship whatsoever.
